name: position_cache
description: GET /pos/cache CBOR response vectors (spec 12-apps.md section 18.2.1). Pins the cache document shape {positions: [{node, lat, lon, ts, alt?, age_s}...]} where age_s is computed at response time as int(now - ts). Bytes are produced by PositionCacheResource.render_get with an injected fixed time_source (lichen.coap.resources.position); encoded_hex equals cbor2.dumps of the produced document. Reject vectors cover record_position validation, which are real ValueError rejections; the GET surface itself has no rejection path.

vectors.name: cache_single_age45
vectors.description: Spec example coordinates (San Francisco) recorded at t0, queried 45 s later: age_s 45, no altitude key.

vectors.name: cache_with_altitude
vectors.description: Entry recorded with altitude 61.5 m (Space Needle): alt key present between ts and age_s per insertion order.

vectors.name: cache_multiple_peers
vectors.description: Three peers cached at different times: ages 5 s, 2 s (with alt), and 15 s; insertion order preserved by the CBOR array.

vectors.name: cache_record_reject_negative_ts
vectors.description: Negative: recording with negative timestamp raises ValueError('timestamp must be non-negative finite number'); nothing enters the cache.
vectors.expected_error: timestamp must be non-negative finite number

vectors.name: cache_record_reject_nan_lat
vectors.description: Negative: recording with NaN latitude raises ValueError('latitude must be finite number'). The 'NaN' string sentinel stands in for float('nan') when driving the oracle.

vectors.name: cache_record_reject_bad_ts_type
vectors.description: Negative: recording with a non-numeric timestamp raises ValueError('timestamp must be non-negative finite number').
vectors.expected_error: timestamp must be non-negative finite number
